name: feedback-clusterer
description: Groups customer feedback you paste into the chat (support tickets, survey answers, app reviews, call notes; a CSV export works best) into themes a PM can put on a roadmap: each with its type, item count, distinct customers, an ARR-weighted share, a trend and verbatim quotes, plus churn signals and caveats. Every count, customer, weight, trend and quote is computed or checked in code; a theme needs 3 items or 2 customers to be shown. Follow-ups work on the stored result: only churn signals, top 3, enterprise only, sort by customers, show quotes, show the items of a theme, or add another batch. It reads only what you paste: no ticket system, no web, and no general questions.

skills.name: Cluster feedback into themes
skills.description: Themes from the feedback you paste, with counts, distinct customers, ARR-weighted share, trend, verbatim quotes, churn signals and caveats, plus follow-ups on the same result.
examples: Cluster this support export and weight by ARR: <paste the CSV>
Only enterprise customers: what are they asking for?
